"GAME DEVELOPMENT MASTER PROMPT

LEGENDS OF AETHER: THE LOST KINGDOM

Create a next-generation, AAA-quality, open-world 3D adventure game titled LEGENDS OF AETHER: THE LOST KINGDOM.

1. Graphics @COMMENT_BODY@ Visual Quality

- Ultra-realistic AAA graphics.
- Stunning 4K-quality textures where supported.
- Realistic character faces, skin, hair, and clothing.
- Dynamic day-and-night cycle.
- Realistic weather: rain, storms, fog, snow, and sunlight.
- Beautiful forests, mountains, rivers, oceans, villages, and ancient castles.
- Advanced lighting, realistic shadows, reflections, and global illumination.
- Cinematic cutscenes and smooth animations.

2. Open World

Create a huge seamless explorable world containing:

- Medieval kingdoms and massive cities.
- Dense forests and mysterious caves.
- Snow-covered mountains.
- Ancient temples and underground dungeons.
- Dangerous enemy camps.
- Hidden treasure locations.
- Secret missions and side quests.
- Wildlife and intelligent NPCs.

3. Gameplay

- Third-person camera with smooth controls.
- Sword combat, archery, magic, and stealth.
- Boss battles and legendary monsters.
- Horse riding and other transportation.
- Climbing, swimming, jumping, and exploration.
- Main storyline with multiple endings.
- Character progression and skill upgrades.
- Collect weapons, armor, resources, and treasures.

4. Enemy AI

- Intelligent enemies with different combat styles.
- Enemies that detect, chase, attack, and defend.
- Powerful boss characters with unique abilities.
- Friendly NPCs with daily routines.
- Dynamic interactions with the environment.

5. Performance Optimization

Performance is a top priority.

- Maintain stable 60 FPS on supported hardware.
- Offer 30 FPS quality mode where necessary.
- Use Level of Detail (LOD) and occlusion culling.
- Implement efficient asset streaming.
- Use optimized textures and mesh compression.
- Implement GPU instancing and efficient draw calls.
- Use adaptive graphics settings.
- Optimize CPU, GPU, RAM, and VRAM usage.
- Prevent memory leaks, stuttering, and unnecessary loading.
- Support scalable graphics for low-end, mid-range, and high-end devices.
- Include resolution scaling and customizable graphics settings.

6. Graphics Settings

Include:

- Low graphics mode.
- Medium graphics mode.
- High graphics mode.
- Ultra graphics mode.
- Custom resolution.
- Shadow quality.
- Texture quality.
- Anti-aliasing.
- Ambient occlusion.
- Motion blur toggle.
- FPS limiter.

7. Audio

- Cinematic orchestral soundtrack.
- Realistic sword and combat sounds.
- Environmental sounds.
- Footsteps and wildlife.
- Immersive character voice acting.

8. UI @COMMENT_BODY@ Controls

- Beautiful modern game interface.
- Health and stamina bars.
- Mini-map and navigation.
- Inventory and equipment.
- Quest tracking.
- Skill tree.
- Smooth keyboard, controller, and mobile touch controls where supported.

9. Technical Requirements

- Build clean, modular, maintainable game architecture.
- Use optimized game assets and animation systems.
- Ensure stable physics and collision detection.
- Add autosave and manual save systems.
- Include loading screens and checkpoints.
- Test performance in large environments.
- Fix crashes, glitches, and gameplay bugs.
- Do not use fake placeholder gameplay or non-functional buttons.

FINAL OBJECTIVE

Deliver a polished, immersive, visually stunning open-world adventure game with exceptional gameplay, beautiful graphics, intelligent AI, smooth animations, and excellent performance.

Prioritize actual playable gameplay, stability, and optimization over graphics effects that reduce performance.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
